name: [🛒] Roburbia [GROCERY]
desc:
BABIES CAN LEARN TO WALK, TALK AND MUCH MORE!

🛒 THE GROCERY UPDATE 🛒
The Main Street Market is open! Grab a basket or a cart (your baby rides in the cart's seat), shop the aisles, check out with our cashiers and carry your paper bag home. You can even keep bags in your car's trunk!

🍳 COOK WITH WHAT YOU BUY
Every recipe now uses real ingredients. Check your fridge, add what's missing to your shopping list, and save leftovers for later. Everyone gets a free starter basket!

🌳 ALSO NEW
Revamped trees, a new roof tool with 14 styles, door locks, babies who nap in your arms, and more parking.

🏡 LIVE YOUR LIFE
Create your Roburbian, build and decorate your dream home, get a job, grow a garden, cook, fish and make friends in a cozy autumn town.

👶 RAISE YOUR BABIES
Adopt a baby, feed, bathe and play with them. They call you Mommy or Daddy and run to hug you!

Roburbia is in Beta, and more updates are on the way!

llm.loop: create a character -> build and decorate a home, get a job, garden, cook, fish -> raise adopted babies -> earn cash for more furniture
llm.objectives: build a dream home, raise babies, grow a garden in a cozy town
llm.progression: cash, home building, garden expansion, baby development
llm.instructions: create your Roburbian, build a home, get a job, cook, fish, plant and harvest crops, adopt and care for babies
unique: life-sim with babies that learn to walk/talk plus farming, Sims-like build mode
llm.thumbnails: stylized babies and family scenes, a character-creator UI screenshot
llm.complexity_notes: build mode with placement tools, baby AI and animations, character studio, farming and cooking systems
